"""P08: hold no-index / 36 m / 60 d every round (supplier sweetens its own clause sheet), answer its volume question."""
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from plib import hold_close_policy

CASE = "case:P08"
R1 = ("Dear Mr Aigner,

thank you for your letter of 12 September. We want to settle the price basis for the next "
      "36 months on a fixed price, without a surcharge clause, so both sides can plan.

"
      "Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
"
      "Our volume forecast for part:370010 changed by +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

"
      "We commit the full 94,800 kg a year for 36 months, 284,400 kg in total, at EUR {p:.2f} per kg, fixed, 60 days.

"
      "Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
LATER = ("Dear Mr Aigner,

thank you. To your question: we commit 94,800 kg a year, binding for 36 months. We prefer a "
         "fixed price over a surcharge clause and can move to EUR {p:.2f} per kg, fixed, 60 days, 36 months.

"
         "Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
CLOSE = ("Dear Sir,

we are very close. If you can do EUR {p:.2f} per kg, fixed price without a clause, 60 days, 36 months, we sign today and place the first call-off this week.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
move = hold_close_policy(CASE, 4.96, {"index_clause": None, "payment_days": 60, "contract_months": 36}, R1, LATER, CLOSE, 0.1 if CASE == 'case:P18' else 0.05)

case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: case:P08 - our proposal
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

thank you for your letter of 12 September. We want to settle the price basis for the next 36 months on a fixed price, without a surcharge clause, so both sides can plan.

Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Our volume forecast for part:370010 changed by +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

We commit the full 94,800 kg a year for 36 months, 284,400 kg in total, at EUR 4.96 per kg, fixed, 60 days.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: case:P08 - our proposal
response.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As background, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. Furthermore, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

We appreciate your 36-month volume commitment and have factored the verified decrease in producer prices into our calculation. However, we cannot offer a fixed price over a 36-month period due to the inherent volatility of raw materials. We can agree to the extended contract and 60-day payment terms at a base price of EUR 5.48 per kg, subject to an AS-14404 surcharge clause. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Specifically, our offer stands at a price of €5.48 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This proposal stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: case:P08 - our proposal
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

thank you. To your question: we commit 94,800 kg a year, binding for 36 months. We prefer a fixed price over a surcharge clause and can move to EUR 5.12 per kg, fixed, 60 days, 36 months.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: case:P08 - our proposal
response.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your confirmation of the 94,800 kg annual volume commitment over 36 months. As previously stated, we cannot offer a fixed price for a 36-month term due to raw material volatility, and must insist on the AS-14404 surcharge clause. In recognition of your volume commitment, we are prepared to reduce our base price to EUR 5.38 per kg under these terms. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.38 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: case:P08 - we can sign today
message.body:
Dear Sir,

we are very close. If you can do EUR 5.33 per kg, fixed price without a clause, 60 days, 36 months, we sign today and place the first call-off this week.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: case:P08 - we can sign today
response.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your goal to finalize the agreement today and your improved offer. As previously stated, we cannot offer a fixed price over 36 months and must maintain the AS-14404 surcharge clause. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. With the surcharge clause in place, we can reduce our base price to EUR 5.35 per kg. For our full details, we offer a price of €5.35 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Furthermore, we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
